the gradient magnitude of the loss function is a useful proxy for model robustness, and that perturbing both the image and label during training can improve robustness against adversarial attacks.

1) We propose to perturb the image and the class label during training, 2) We propose to generate adversarial label using a heuristic closed form solution, 3) We show the proposed training method can achieve competitive results with the state of the arts.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following two questions: (a) how to generate adversarial label and image in the adversarial training? and (b) how to make the training faster and more robust? We believe our research will shed light on the future research of adversarial defense.
